geometry_availability.rule: Exact frozen-geometry identity only; held systems have no balance-normalized outcome.

interpretation: Removing only the exact binary state-balance attenuation term rescues 50/167 geometry-matched Mk2-rho no-bracket systems with zero new failures among 105 matched Mk2-rho calibrated systems. The full-population no-bracket rate is bounded at 42.4%-43.8% after explicit accounting for four outcome-free geometry holds. State balance therefore explains a substantial additional part of the categorical accessibility bottleneck, but a large unresolved remainder persists even after generator substitution and balance normalization.
interpretation_guard: Geometry-HOLD systems are excluded only by a frozen pre-outcome identity gate and are explicitly accounted for. The balance-normalized statistic removes one algebraic state-balance attenuation term; it is a mechanism diagnostic, not a universal estimator recommendation.
